body: This session ran the whole macOS end-to-end test of Field Notes on d36b748, then, with the owner's permission, the checks that had been left as hand checks.U+000AU+000AMain run (in-app input only, watchdog armed): M0 to M15 all pass for a sighted user. A live accessibility sweep of a plain build (renamed bundle, own data container) found that Settings and the open month picker never reach the macOS accessibility tree. Carried-forward findings: the floated-photo drag is confirmed in a changed form, the file-URL paste failure was a harness bug, and Ctrl+K is confirmed dead. A month-picker crash first logged as a VoiceOver defect turned out to be probe-only (0 of 2 in the real app).U+000AU+000AFollow-up under decision 01M3JBKS7G9AMEKFBP5JTPA3Z7 (tagged, capped HID input; settings restored): the Edit menu failure is confirmed with a real mouse; real Finder copy and drag work; accents, Japanese, full screen, Light/Dark and spell check work; sound plays. New: MB2, the daily reminder never fires on the Mac (no build is registered for notifications); H11, Chinese Pinyin cannot compose in the note editor. Real VoiceOver reading was not completed: the owner stayed active through two 10-minute idle waits. VoiceOver was switched off, and its preference restored.U+000AU+000AThe owner was on a Discord call on a Bluetooth headset. Test audio went to their headset, and the test voice memo, its blob and its temporary file were deleted.U+000AU+000AAll findings are recorded as thread risks (MB1, MB2, H1 to H11, cosmetic C1 to C8, harness notes) and in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/E2E-REPORT.md. The session's tools are saved to testkit/tools-2026-09-27 with two new patches. Mac state left: Warp's Automation permission for VoiceOver stays on, since switching it off needs the owner's Touch ID; the plain test app holds test data in dev.satanshumishra.fieldNotes.plain; the owner's real app data was never opened.
